features.title: Install root deps in CI; surface pack errors
features.user_visible_behavior: The invariants CI job passes; a failed npm pack in install.sh names the step.
features.evidence: GREEN 2026-11-17 (ac4fe73): clean checkout without node_modules → install.sh fails with 'npm pack failed … Cannot find package esbuild'; after npm ci → 'OK asdd install smoke test'. Workflow runs npm ci before the tests.
